propositions: Empirical measurement of plan-review and completion-verifier operation durations via sidecar telemetry yields p50/p90/p99 statistics to establish operator wait-time expectations.

End-to-end command wall time (outer measurement from terminal invocation to completion) is substantially longer than inner workflow total_ms because deterministic setup, post-sidecar overlap-judge work, and pre-verifier impact scanning are excluded from sidecar metrics.

Current performance regime (after 2026-08-22) for plan review is about 15-22 minutes padded; gated close transitions are about 35-70 minutes padded, with the dominant tail driven by referencing_commits and ticket-directory scanning.

Inner workflow metrics show plan-review p50/p90/p99 of 189/325/443 seconds and completion p50/p90/p99 of 87/156/749 seconds, but operator wait includes omitted setup and tail work of 154/629/2148 seconds and 408/2110/3514 seconds respectively.
The post-fix provider attribution and explicit llm_calls > 0 inclusion rule isolate model-active runs; broader pools and missing-provenance sensitivity do not alter core statistics materially.

Discovery of grassy-cracked-morpho (impact-present close-precheck scanning bottleneck) explains the current close-transition tail; existing bug reportable-chalkstony-eeve addressed only empty-impact cases.
